CN_01.title: Basic Information and Arsenal Assessment
CN_01.summary: Sarkaz female exhibiting negative Oripathy markers yet extraordinary Arts conductivity. Brought an anomalous annular ring structure upon arrival, which interfaces dynamically with her standard-issue sword.

CN_02.title: Human Resources Summary
CN_02.summary: Assigned under the direct authority of the Endministrator. Independent disposition, minimal factional alignment, and uncooperative toward conventional corporate hierarchies.

CN_03.title: Rhodes Island Confidential Dispatch
CN_03.summary: Recovered from the deep Originium Woods with complete polymnestic amnesia. Striking biological and psychological likeness to Operator Surtr from historical Terra records. Explicit directive issued: Under no circumstances should personnel compare her to Surtr unless initiated by Laevatain herself.
